sources.days_1_14: ECMWF IFS ensemble via Open-Meteo (about 14 days of non-null members). Skill below uses previous-runs deterministic leads, not a second decoder.
sources.days_15_46: No public ECMWF extended-range member feed past ~14 days on ensemble-api.open-meteo.com (forecast_days=46 returns HTTP 400; day 15+ members are null). SEAS5 from the Open-Meteo seasonal API is used instead.
sources.days_47_180: ECMWF SEAS5 via https://seasonal-api.open-meteo.com (no CDS key). CDS_API_KEY is accepted but unused while this endpoint works.
sources.cds: Not required for the path that ran. Direct Copernicus CDS was not called.
sources.observations: Lead skill and drift use Open-Meteo archive temperatures where validated SHMU days are missing. SHMU validated daily climate (station 11816) covers 2025-01 through 2026-08 and is the climate-driver target. Previous runs used here start in mid-August 2026, so almost all lead samples are archive observations, not station minutes.

15-46.note: The Open-Meteo seasonal API listed the past dates but every SEAS5 member value was null, so no Brier or CRPS could be computed. Direct CDS hindcasts were not called.

47-180.note: The Open-Meteo seasonal API listed the past dates but every SEAS5 member value was null, so no Brier or CRPS could be computed. Direct CDS hindcasts were not called.
